blurb: Welcome to Hershey Road Campground, a gorgeous 20-acre, family and pet-oriented destination park outside of Hershey, Pennsylvania. Our completely remodeled campground offers world class amenities; from our heated outdoor pool & splash pad to brand new RV sites. We proudly offer a variety of RV and tent sites as well as cabin rentals within our serene, rural setting.
